sources.title: Building & Publishing Your Webpage with Codex
sources.description: Ever wanted to build your own website but weren't sure where to start? In this beginner-friendly 2-hour workshop, you'll create your very own one-page website and put it online for the world to see-no experience needed! With the help of Codex, a smart AI assistant that writes code for you, you'll bring your ideas to life just by describing what you want. We'll walk through everything together, step by step, from designing your page to publishing it live on GitLab Pages with its own shareable link. By the end, you'll have a real website you built yourself and the confidence to keep creating. Come as you are and leave with something you made!
